defs.def: a set of parts ready to be made into sth 配套元件

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

defs.def: a set of tools or equipment that you use for a particular purpose 成套工具；成套设备

ex.s: EMERGENCY SUPPLIES water and food for three days radio flashlight whistle first aid kit First/First of all, you should ...
ex.t: 紧急物资：三天份的水和食物、收音机、手电筒、哨子、急救包。首先／首先，你应该……

ex.s: UNIT 5 FIRST AID *Project 2: Make your own first-aid kit 2 Research how to perform first aid for that medical emergency.
ex.t: 第五单元 急救：项目2——制作你自己的急救包。研究如何为该医疗紧急情况实施急救。

ex.s: In most cases, the items for a first-aid kit can be bought cheaply at a pharmacy.
ex.t: 在大多数情况下，急救包中的物品可以在药店廉价买到。

ex.s: Fortunately, a special kit has been developed.
ex.t: 幸运的是，已经开发出了一种专门的工具包。

ex.s: Preparing for an adventurous trip Take the things you need food supplies · A (3) kit A torch A hiking map A (2) A good backpack Practise carrying your backpack A fully loaded backpack should be no (4) of your body weight.
ex.t: 为一次冒险旅行做准备：带上你需要的东西——食物补给·一个(3)套装、一把手电筒、一张徒步地图、一个(2)好背包。练习背着你的背包：一个装满的背包重量不应超过你体重的(4)。

defs.def: a set of clothes and equipment that you use for a particular activity 全套衣服及装备

chunks.cn: 援助成套工具 / 特殊的成套工具 / 供应成套工具
